decisions.decision: The Task Force will make additional public presentations, per the Board of Selectmen directive, to address unanswered questions on the Stretch Code, HERS raters, necessity and cost.

budget_items.topic: Solar Landfill Project power line upgrade
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated cost to upgrade the power lines for the Solar Landfill Project was reported, with a more accurate cost to follow.
budget_items.quote: the estimated cost to upgrade the power lines was $200,000.00 but they will be giving a more accurate cost soon

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The THMS solar project produced 56 kW at a reported savings.
budget_items.quote: the thms solar project has produced 56 kw of power at a savings of $10,000.00.

budget_items.topic: MASS PV1 Chase Road PILOT payment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: MASS PV1 is negotiating a Pilot Program agreement under which it would pay the Town in lieu of taxes.
budget_items.quote: where they would pay the town $24,000.00 in lieu of taxes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: J. Londa said Energy Performance Contracts could reduce cost with no up-front investment by the Town; the contracted company would receive the financial benefits from revenue generated.
budget_items.quote: the town does not have to invest any money up front but the contracted company would get all the financial benefits

budget_items.topic: Financial impact of Green Community Act and Stretch Code
budget_items.what_was_recorded: J. Londa stressed a financial impact to the Town through energy-reduction savings and grants; no figures were given.
budget_items.quote: j. londa stressed that there is indeed a financial impact to the town through savings in energy reduction and grants

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Questions were raised about what the Task Force can accomplish without funds and whether money can be matched; no figures were given.
budget_items.quote: what can the task force accomplish without funds?
